live_notify.confirm_forget: Delete the webhook URL? No Discord message will go out afterwards.
live_notify.discord.no_webhook_hint: No webhook URL is stored – without it no message goes out. It lives under Plugins → Settings.
live_notify.error.bad_login: That is not a valid Twitch login. Allowed are lower-case letters, digits and underscore, up to 25 characters.
live_notify.error.bad_webhook: That does not look like a Discord webhook URL. It starts with https://discord.com/api/webhooks/.
live_notify.error.no_such_channel: Twitch does not know the channel “%{login}”.
live_notify.error.unknown_target: This target or channel is unknown.
live_notify.error.webhook_gone: Discord no longer knows this webhook. It was probably deleted there.
live_notify.error.webhook_rate_limit: Discord is throttling. Please wait a moment.
live_notify.error.webhook_rejected: Discord rejected the URL. It is probably mistyped.
live_notify.is_off: Live notification is turned off – nothing is being checked and nothing is reported.
live_notify.lead: Watches other channels and reports when one of them goes live.
live_notify.message_hint: Leave empty for the default. Discord understands Markdown – **bold** becomes bold.
live_notify.name: Live notification
live_notify.no_channels: No channels yet. Add one and you will be told as soon as it goes live.
live_notify.no_targets: No target is enabled – so channels are watched but nobody is told.
live_notify.perm.add: may add channels to the watch list.
live_notify.perm.delete: may remove channels from the watch list.
live_notify.perm.edit: may change the webhook, the message template and the targets per channel.
live_notify.perm.toggle: may turn live notification on and off.
live_notify.perm.view: may see the watched channels and the settings.
live_notify.settings_lead: Where the message goes and what it looks like.
live_notify.test_title: A test from the Twitch controller
live_notify.toggle_hint: Turn live notification on or off
live_notify.turned_off: Live notification turned off. Nothing is checked and nothing is reported any more.
live_notify.webhook_hint: Create it in Discord under Channel → Settings → Integrations → Webhooks. The URL is stored encrypted and never shown again – whoever has it can post to that channel.
